English: Scroll Chest
A sturdy, lockable chest for storing precious scrolls, protecting knowledge from the harsh elements of the steppe.
Scribes Desk
A simple wooden desk for copying texts and keeping clan records, enabling a rudimentary bureaucracy.
Reading Alcove
A canvas-and-wooden shelter where elders gather to study and discuss written works, fostering unity and learning.
Stone Study
A semi-permanent stone-built shelter, protecting collection and scholars alike, a symbol of permanence amid the steppes.
Scriptorium
A dedicated building for copying and illuminating texts, attracting learned men from distant lands.
Book Nook
A cozy, fire-warmed chamber where tomes and codices are safely stored under lock and key, encouraging literacy among the elite.
Copyists Hall
A grand hall bustling with scribes and apprentices, producing copies for the clan and for trade, spreading Latinate learning across the steppes.
Scholars' Room
A secure, lamp-lit chamber where learned men debate philosophy, law, and administration, furthering the clans wisdom and prestige.
Archivists Library
A fortified library employing archivists to catalogue, preserve, and secure the clans knowledge, with growing renown among scholars afar.
Grand Latin Library
The preeminent center of Latinate learning in the nomad world, attracting scholars, boosting population, and cementing the clans legacy in the annals of history.
